comparisons.peer_summary: Technical teams, including application engineers and solution architects, provide pre-sales assistance to optimize infrastructure for generative AI, LLMs, and enterprise applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies highlight the use of specialized technical personnel to assist customers in optimizing their infrastructure and workflows, though they serve different industries. Broadcom's ValueOps solution focuses on software value stream management to align business and development teams for planning and execution (sentence avgo_2024_1_P026_S005). Similarly, NVIDIA employs application engineers and solution architects to provide pre-sales assistance, specifically helping partners optimize hardware and software infrastructure for generative AI and LLM training (sentences nvda_2024_1_P040_S002, nvda_2024_1_P040_S003). While Broadcom's focus is on enterprise software delivery efficiency, NVIDIA's focus is on accelerating AI application deployment; both strategies rely on deep technical support to reduce customer friction and improve time-to-value/outcomes.

sentences.text: • ValueOps: This solution delivers value stream management capabilities that enable customers to schedule, track, and manage work throughout its lifecycle from investment planning to execution. It aligns business and development teams across the enterprise, increasing transparency, reducing inefficiencies, and improving time to value.

We also employ a team of application engineers and solution architects to provide pre-sales assistance to our partner network in designing, testing, and qualifying system designs that incorporate our platforms.
For example, our solution architects work with CSPs to provide pre-sales assistance to optimize their hardware and software infrastructure for generative AI and LLM training and deployment.
